dialogues.jp:
涙の跡が乾いた頃、空を見ながら頼子さんは言っ
た。
dialogues.en: "Some are already tired of it, though."
dialogues.text: "Some are already tired of it, though."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「初音島の人は幸せですね。こんな綺麗なもの、
　毎日見られるんですから……」
dialogues.en: "Maybe it's true, but......"
dialogues.text: "Maybe it's true, but......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「すでに、見飽きてるって説もあるけどね」
dialogues.en: "But to me, it is very beautiful......"
dialogues.text: "But to me, it is very beautiful......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私にとっては、とても綺麗です……」
頼子さんと同じように、空を見上げた。
dialogues.en: I look up at the sky as well.
dialogues.text: I look up at the sky as well.

dialogues.jp:
春の風は強く、時折、桜の花びらが魚群のよう
に一斉に動く。
dialogues.en:
The spring wind's strong, and sometimes it blows cherry
blossom petals like schools of fish.
dialogues.text:
The spring wind's strong, and sometimes it blows cherry
blossom petals like schools of fish.

dialogues.jp:
風の後は、ただ静寂があるばかりで、花びらは
静かに降り積もる雪のようだ。
dialogues.en:
After the gust of wind, there's nothing but silence, and the
petals fall down like snow.
dialogues.text:
After the gust of wind, there's nothing but silence, and the
petals fall down like snow.

dialogues.jp:
しんしんと。そのまま行けば、地球の全土を覆っ
てしまうんじゃないか。そんなことまで思って
しまう。
dialogues.en:
They fall so quietly, and they make me think they could
cover up the whole earth if they kept falling like this.
dialogues.text:
They fall so quietly, and they make me think they could
cover up the whole earth if they kept falling like this.

dialogues.jp: そして、また、風。
dialogues.en: And another gust of wind blows.
dialogues.text: And another gust of wind blows.

dialogues.jp: 尽きることがなく、花は、空を舞っていく。
dialogues.en:
The petals are flying and dancing in the air like there's no
end.
dialogues.text:
The petals are flying and dancing in the air like there's no
end.

dialogues.jp:
「不思議だよな、やっぱ……。枯れない桜だな
　んて……」
dialogues.en:
"It's strange...... that these cherry blossoms never
die......"
dialogues.text:
"It's strange...... that these cherry blossoms never
die......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい……。何だか、優しい感じがします……」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... I feel a kindness in them......"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... I feel a kindness in them......"

dialogues.jp: 柔らかな笑みで、頼子さんは頷いた。
dialogues.en: Yoriko-san softly smiles and nods.
dialogues.text: Yoriko-san softly smiles and nods.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「まるで、初音島の人達を……見守ってくれて
　いるような気がするんです」
dialogues.en:
"I feel as if they're watching over the people on Hatsune
Island."
dialogues.text:
"I feel as if they're watching over the people on Hatsune
Island."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「桜……枯れる事のない桜が、ずっと？」
dialogues.en:
"These cherry blossoms......? These cherry blossoms that
never die are watching over us forever?"
dialogues.text:
"These cherry blossoms......? These cherry blossoms that
never die are watching over us forever?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「優しい、まるで、ゆりかごのように、人々を
　守っている……。そんな感じでしょうか」
dialogues.en:
"......They're like a very kind cradle watching over
us...... or something like that."
dialogues.text:
"......They're like a very kind cradle watching over
us...... or something like that."

dialogues.jp:
島の桜をそんな風に形容するのを聞いたのは、
初めてだった。
dialogues.en:
It's the first time I've heard anyone describe the cherry
blossoms of this island like that.
dialogues.text:
It's the first time I've heard anyone describe the cherry
blossoms of this island like that.

dialogues.jp:
改めて桜に目を遣る。姿形は寸分も変わってい
ないのに、何だか別の物のように見えた。
dialogues.en:
I look at the cherry blossoms again. They're not changed a
bit but they look different now somehow.
dialogues.text:
I look at the cherry blossoms again. They're not changed a
bit but they look different now somehow.

dialogues.jp: ゆりかごか……。
dialogues.en: A cradle......
dialogues.text: A cradle......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「でも、人はいつか、ゆりかごから出なければ
　ならないんですよね……」
dialogues.en: "But people have to leave the cradle someday......"
dialogues.text: "But people have to leave the cradle someday......"

dialogues.jp: ぽつりとした、独り言のような呟きだった。
dialogues.en: She murmurs as if she's talking to herself.
dialogues.text: She murmurs as if she's talking to herself.

dialogues.jp:
「ん？　それは、一般論？　それとも、いつか
　は島の桜も枯れるって事？」
dialogues.en:
"What? Is that a general opinion? Or do you mean that the
cherry blossoms will die eventually?"
dialogues.text:
"What? Is that a general opinion? Or do you mean that the
cherry blossoms will die eventually?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……そんな深い意味はないんですよ。ただ、
　思い浮かんだ事を言っただけです……」
dialogues.en:
"......I didn't mean anything. ......I was just saying what
came into my mind......"
dialogues.text:
"......I didn't mean anything. ......I was just saying what
came into my mind......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Oh, okay......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, okay......"

dialogues.en: 'But' 'What is this bad feeling I have?'
dialogues.text: 'But' 'What is this bad feeling I have?'

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「こんな話があるのを、知ってますか……？」
dialogues.en: "Have you heard of a story about......"
dialogues.text: "Have you heard of a story about......"

dialogues.jp:
公園の、とある方向に顔を向ける。頭の中に地
図を描き、その先にあるものは──、
dialogues.en:
She looks in a particular direction. Drawing a map of this
park in my head, I remember that that direction leads
to......
dialogues.text:
She looks in a particular direction. Drawing a map of this
park in my head, I remember that that direction leads
to......

dialogues.jp: （秘密基地……か）
dialogues.en: (My secret hideout......)
dialogues.text: (My secret hideout......)

dialogues.jp:
俺にとっては思い出の場所。それこそ、ゆりか
ごのような、桜の大木がある。
dialogues.en:
A place which holds many fond memories to me, where there's
a big cherry blossom tree that looks like a cradle, just
like she said earlier.
dialogues.text:
A place which holds many fond memories to me, where there's
a big cherry blossom tree that looks like a cradle, just
like she said earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「この公園には……他の桜よりもずっと大きい、
　１本の大木があるんです……」
dialogues.en:
"There is a huge tree in this park... bigger than any other
cherry tree......"
dialogues.text:
"There is a huge tree in this park... bigger than any other
cherry tree......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、あるね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I know."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I know."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「知っていました？」
dialogues.en: "You knew?"
dialogues.text: "You knew?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ま、それなりには」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, sort of."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, sort of."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「では……その桜が、願いを叶えてくれるとい
　うのは、どうですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Then...... do you also know that the tree will make your
wish come true?"
dialogues.text:
"Then...... do you also know that the tree will make your
wish come true?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「願いを叶えて……くれる？」
dialogues.en: "It will make my wish come...... true?"
dialogues.text: "It will make my wish come...... true?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんへと視線を移す。彼女の滑らかな頬が、
星明かりにぼんやりと光っている。
dialogues.en:
I look at Yoriko. Her smooth cheeks are shining in the
starlight.
dialogues.text:
I look at Yoriko. Her smooth cheeks are shining in the
starlight.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、知らないな。そんな噂、あったっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't know that. I haven't even heard anyone tell a
fairy tale like that."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't know that. I haven't even heard anyone tell a
fairy tale like that."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「噂じゃありませんよ……」
dialogues.en: "This isn't a fairy tale......"
dialogues.text: "This isn't a fairy tale......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「本当の事……です」
dialogues.en: "This is true......"
dialogues.text: "This is true......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの桜は……｛しんし／真摯｝な願いを叶えてくれる……」
dialogues.en:
"That cherry blossom tree...... does make your sincerest
wish come true......"
dialogues.text:
"That cherry blossom tree...... does make your sincerest
wish come true......"

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは胸の前で両手を組んだ。まるで、祈っ
ているかのような姿。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko is clasping her hands in front of her chest like she
is praying.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko is clasping her hands in front of her chest like she
is praying.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それが本当に……心からの願いであれば」
dialogues.en: "If the wish really comes from your heart..."
dialogues.text: "If the wish really comes from your heart..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「へえ……じゃ、俺も願ってみようかな」
dialogues.en: "Really...... then I should wish something, too."
dialogues.text: "Really...... then I should wish something, too."

dialogues.jp:
ちゃかすように言う。頼子さんはこちらに振り
向くと、にこりと微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: I say as a joke. Yoriko looks at me and smiles.
dialogues.text: I say as a joke. Yoriko looks at me and smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それが、純粋な祈りであるならば……きっと」
dialogues.en: "If your wish is pure...... it will."
dialogues.text: "If your wish is pure...... it will."

dialogues.jp: 彼女は再び、祈りの対象に向き直った。
不思議な、透明感のある表情だと思う。
dialogues.en:
She turns her head back toward the object of her prayer
again.
dialogues.text:
She turns her head back toward the object of her prayer
again.

dialogues.jp: ヒュウウ……。
dialogues.en: The expression on her face is so mysterious but so clear.
dialogues.text: The expression on her face is so mysterious but so clear.

dialogues.jp:
ひときわ強い風が吹き、公園の中が桜の花びら
で満たされる。
dialogues.en: Fwooo...
dialogues.text: Fwooo...

dialogues.jp:
人の願いは、こんな風に渦巻いているのかもし
れないな。不意に、そんな事を思った。
dialogues.en:
A very strong gust of wind blows, and the park is filled
with cherry blossom petals.
dialogues.text:
A very strong gust of wind blows, and the park is filled
with cherry blossom petals.

dialogues.jp: だとすれば、きっと届くのは一握りに違いない。
dialogues.en:
I suddenly think that maybe people's wishes are always
swirling in a wind like this.
dialogues.text:
I suddenly think that maybe people's wishes are always
swirling in a wind like this.

dialogues.jp:
渦巻き、｛たわむ／戯｝れる人の願いは、あまりに雑多で、
圧倒的で……。桜だって、そうそう全ては、｛すく／掬｝
いきれないはず。
dialogues.en: If so, there are only a few wishes that really come true.
dialogues.text: If so, there are only a few wishes that really come true.

dialogues.jp: 俺の考えに呼応したのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
I think those people's wishes that flit from one petal to
another in a swirling wind are too overwhelming and crowded
for the cherry tree to catch them all so easily.
dialogues.text:
I think those people's wishes that flit from one petal to
another in a swirling wind are too overwhelming and crowded
for the cherry tree to catch them all so easily.

dialogues.jp:
風に乗って、俺の耳へと届いた頼子さんの声は
──、
dialogues.en:
Did she just answer my thoughts? Her voice is carried by a
gust of wind and reaches my ears.
dialogues.text:
Did she just answer my thoughts? Her voice is carried by a
gust of wind and reaches my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私の願いは……叶えられたのでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Did my wish...... come true......?"
dialogues.text: "Did my wish...... come true......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それが真摯な願いならば、でしょ？」
dialogues.en: "If it was a sincere wish, right?"
dialogues.text: "If it was a sincere wish, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですね」
dialogues.en: "......That's right."
dialogues.text: "......That's right."

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんはすっくと立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: She stands up quietly.
dialogues.text: She stands up quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そろそろ、帰りませんか？　寒いです……」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go home now? I'm getting cold......"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go home now? I'm getting cold......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yes, let's."
dialogues.text: "Yes, let's."

dialogues.jp:
やや重たくなっていた腰を上げ、頼子さんの隣
に立つ。
dialogues.en: Picking up my heavy butt, I stand up next to Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text: Picking up my heavy butt, I stand up next to Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp: 「腕組んで、帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "Let's walk back arm in arm."
dialogues.text: "Let's walk back arm in arm."

dialogues.jp:
恥ずかしさと照れをまぶした、けれど、冗談は
小さじの一杯もなく、俺はそう言った。
dialogues.en:
I'm embarrassed and probably sound shy when I ask her, but
I'm not joking.
dialogues.text:
I'm embarrassed and probably sound shy when I ask her, but
I'm not joking.

dialogues.jp: すっと、腕が腕に絡んでくる。
dialogues.en: She quietly puts her arm through mine.
dialogues.text: She quietly puts her arm through mine.

dialogues.jp: 春の夜は、心地のいい涼しさだった。
dialogues.en: The spring night air is cool and pleasant.
dialogues.text: The spring night air is cool and pleasant.

dialogues.jp: ◆桜の秘密◆
dialogues.en: ◆Yoriko◆
dialogues.text: ◆Yoriko◆

dialogues.jp:
夜桜の舞う桜公園で、頼子さんから、願いを叶
えてくれるというこの島の巨大な桜の樹の話を
聞いた。
dialogues.en:
When the traces of her tears dry, she starts to talk,
looking at the sky.
dialogues.text:
When the traces of her tears dry, she starts to talk,
looking at the sky.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんの願いは叶えられたのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
"People living on Hatsune Island are very lucky......
because they can see this beautiful view everyday."
dialogues.text:
"People living on Hatsune Island are very lucky......
because they can see this beautiful view everyday."
